INTERNAL_VARIABLES.Description: During the early Fuse client 2.0 Beta many of the internal cast variables were in the variables.txt.

asset.base.url.Name: Client assets base path
asset.base.url.Description: The base path used to resolve relative client assets.

catalog.offer.data.url.Name: Catalog offers localization file
catalog.offer.data.url.Description: The URL of the file containing the localization data of catalog offer's names and descriptions.

command.list.user.Name: User targeted commands
command.list.user.Description: List of commands that replace the character "x" in the first parameter of the command with the username of the selected user.

core.asset.Name: Client core files
core.asset.Description: Files the client is required to download before starting up.

entry.Description: Group of different entries to be selected. Only one should be active at given time.

normal.Description: Remaining files are loaded on room load.

small.Description: Zoomed out. Remaining files are loaded on room entry.

normal.Description: Remaining files are loaded on room load.

small.Description: Zoomed out. Remaining files are loaded on room load.

classic.Description: Group of classic clotching. Zoomed out files are loaded on room entry.

shared.Description: Internal shared library for basic client functionality.

patch.Description: Group of different localization specific patches for assets, texts and logic. Only one should be active at given time.

room_utils.Description: Shared classes for public and private rooms and games.

room_ui.Description: Shared UI elements for public and private rooms and games.

dynamic.Description: Group of dynamic furniture loading logic.
Group of dynamic catalog related files.

friend_list.Description: New messenger friend list UI and logic.

instant_messenger.Description: New messenger chat UI & and logic.

core.base.url.Name: Client files base path
core.base.url.Description: The base path used to resolve relative client files.

core.configuration.data.url.Name: Client configuration file
core.configuration.data.url.Description: The URL of the client configuration file.

core.configuration.hash.data.url.Name: Game data hashes file
core.configuration.hash.data.url.Description: The URL of the game data hashes file.

core.localization.Name: Client localization options
core.localization.Description: The available localizations for the client. These are shown in the AIR client hotel selection. The client language can also be switched by the :lang command.

id.Description: The id used by the :lang command.

core.localization.data.url.Name: Client localization file
core.localization.data.url.Description: The URL of the file containing the client localization data.

core.url.Name: Client game file
core.url.Description: The URL of the client game file. This is the file that is opened to launch the client.

core.version.id.Name: Client version
core.version.id.Description: The version number the client sends to the server.

cryptography.parameter.data.url.Name: Secure cast file path
cryptography.parameter.data.url.Description: The URL of the secure cast file. This contains the cryptography generator and prime used to generate the client's private key.

furniture.asset.base.url.Name: Furniture assets base path
furniture.asset.base.url.Description: The base path used to resolve furniture files.

furniture.asset.icon.url.template.Name: Furniture icon file template
furniture.asset.icon.url.template.Description: The furniture icon file name template.

furniture.data.url.Name: Furniture data file
furniture.data.url.Description: The URL of the furniture data file.

http.request.limit.max.Name: Concurrent HTTP requests limit
http.request.limit.max.Description: The maximum amount of concurrent HTTP requests the client is allowed to make.

human.figure.animation.data.url.Name: Human animation data file
human.figure.animation.data.url.Description: The URL of the human animation data file.

human.figure.asset.base.url.Name: Human assets base path
human.figure.asset.base.url.Description: The base path used to resolve clothing files.

human.figure.data.url.Name: Clothing data file
human.figure.data.url.Description: The URL of the clothing data file.

human.figure.map.data.url.Name: Human assets map file
human.figure.map.data.url.Description: The URL of the human assets map file.

human.figure.part.Name: Human asset parts
human.figure.part.Description: The parts that the human object consist of. The asset prefixes used in the human size configuration are used here as the key.

human.figure.part.set.data.url.Name: Human part sets file
human.figure.part.set.data.url.Description: The URL of the human part sets file.

human.figure.render.canvas.Name: Human geometry
human.figure.render.canvas.Description: The configuration used to render the human according to its state. The asset prefixes used in the human size configuration are used here as the key and then the respective state.

states.geometry.width.Name: Width
states.geometry.width.Description: The width required to render the human correctly.

states.geometry.height.Name: Height
states.geometry.height.Description: The height required to render the human correctly.

states.geometry.offset_y.Name: Offset Y
states.geometry.offset_y.Description: Modifies the relative vertical render offset.

human.figure.render.order.data.url.Name: Human assets draw order file
human.figure.render.order.data.url.Description: The URL of the human assets draw order file.

image.asset.base.url.Name: Image library base path
image.asset.base.url.Description: The base path used to resolve image files.

pet.figure.asset.base.url.Name: Pet assets base path
pet.figure.asset.base.url.Description: The base path used to resolve pet files.

pet.figure.asset.url.template.Name: Pet assets file template
pet.figure.asset.url.template.Description: The pet assets file name template.

room.asset.Name: Room files
room.asset.Description: Files the client is required to download before entering a room.

room.map.cache.Name: Room heightmap cache
room.map.cache.Description: Whatever to cache room heightmap. Not recommended to be turned on, as its likely to cause desync when changes are made.

server.connection.channel.Name: Client connection channel id
server.connection.channel.Description: Controls which channel the client uses for different connections. Not recommended to be changed from the given defaults.

server.connection.endpoint.Name: Server connection info
server.connection.endpoint.Description: The address the client attempt's to connect to.

shockwave.Description: Shockwave client only supports a single port.

flash.Description: Flash client supports multiple ports that it attempts to connect against in declaration order.

development.Description: Connection info used during development to connect to the local server.

production.Description: Connection info used for the live server.

sso.ticket.Name: SSO ticket
sso.ticket.Description: The SSO ticket used to authenticate the user to the server.

sso.ticket.enabled.Name: SSO ticket enabled
sso.ticket.enabled.Description: Whatever the client should use SSO ticket to authenticate the user to the server.

text.encoding.utf8.Name: Client UTF-8 text encoding enabled
text.encoding.utf8.Description: Toggles whatever the client should use UTF-8 encoding for text or fallback to a region specific code pages. The client may not support this or permit it to be switched from the default encoding. This option has compatibility considerations on whatever all text renders correctly across different regions. It may also have different performance characteristics depending on whatever the client has to emulate the encoding on top of its own native encoding.

ui.font.Name: Client font data
ui.font.Description: Font definitions used by the Shockwave client.

font.color.Name: Color
font.color.Description: The RGB color as a HTML color code.

plain.Name: Plain
plain.Description: The font that's generally used on most labels.

italic.Name: Italic
italic.Description: The font used for italic text.

tooltip.Name: Tooltip
tooltip.Description: The font used by the debug tooltip window.
